hud.fail.positive: Better challenge a more mediocre {{fishName}} instead
hud.fail.epic: Collect more badges (crowns on the fish collection page) for more bonuses, then challenge this epic champion again.
hud.fail.union: You must enter the state of man-fish unity. You must BE the fish to win this challenge.
hud.starfruitTea.1: The elegant {{fishName}} had Stardrop Tea this morning—its scales are practically sparkling.
hud.starfruitTea.2: {{fishName}} whispers that it drank Stardrop Tea today and felt invincible... until your hook showed up.
hud.starfruitTea.3: Rumor has it {{fishName}} is a devoted Stardrop Tea drinker. Just smell that tea-scented fish.
hud.starfruitTea.4: {{fishName}} protests mid-struggle: it hasn’t finished its Stardrop Tea—why did you reel in so soon!
hud.starfruitTea.5: This {{fishName}} drank Stardrop Tea and thought it could command the seas, until it met your hook.
hud.starfruitTea.6: {{fishName}} had Stardrop Tea for breakfast, and now its belly glows like a tiny lantern.
hud.starfruitTea.7: You can smell Stardrop Tea on {{fishName}}—it was just enjoying a snack at the bottom of the lake.
hud.starfruitTea.8: {{fishName}} planned a graceful escape after its tea... and gracefully landed in your backpack.
hud.starfruitTea.9: This {{fishName}} is a true tea connoisseur, carrying Stardrop Tea everywhere. Care for a sip?
hud.starfruitTea.10: {{fishName}} got caught sipping Stardrop Tea and shyly swam into your tackle box.
hud.starfruitTea.11: {{fishName}} had Stardrop Tea with a waterweed sandwich this morning and is in a great mood.
hud.starfruitTea.12: {{fishName}} boasts that the whole lake is its tea room—then gets yanked out, tea and all.
hud.starfruitTea.13: When you reeled in {{fishName}}, it was clutching half a bottle of Stardrop Tea. Caught red-handed!
hud.starfruitTea.14: {{fishName}} drank Stardrop Tea and dreamed of swimming all seven seas... then hit your bait.
hud.starfruitTea.15: This {{fishName}} carries itself with Stardrop Tea nobility—even its struggles look classy.

hud.exhaust.1.4: [{{rankName}}]It has less strength, but keeps going
hud.exhaust.1.8: [{{rankName}}]It seems to regret biting the hook
hud.exhaust.3.5: [{{rankName}}]It seems to be taking a breather
hud.exhaust.5.4: [{{rankName}}]It lounges like it is in a hot spring
hud.exhaust.5.6: [{{rankName}}]It surfaces to gasp more and more
hud.exhaust.5.7: [{{rankName}}]It cannot even be bothered to tail-flick
hud.exhaust.7.7: [{{rankName}}]Its force is about a gentle massage
hud.exhaust.9.5: [{{rankName}}]The light in its eyes is gone
hud.exhaust.9.9: [{{rankName}}]Out of stamina, holding on by willpower
hud.exhaust.12.9: [{{rankName}}]Stubborn after the stamina bar hit zero
hud.exhaust.15.7: [{{rankName}}]It is about to raise a white flag
hud.exhaust.15.8: [{{rankName}}]Its eyes are empty, at your mercy
hud.exhaust.15.9: [{{rankName}}]Too tired to remember its own name
hud.exhaust.15.10: [{{rankName}}]Flat-out lying down, waiting for the reel
hud.exhaust.append.1: But it will not betray your resolve
hud.exhaust.append.2: But it is glad to meet a worthy opponent
hud.exhaust.append.3: But it wants this duel to continue
hud.exhaust.append.4: But you are worth its last ounce of strength
hud.exhaust.append.5: Yet it says: it is not time to give up
hud.exhaust.append.6: But its pride will not let it fall
hud.exhaust.append.7: Yet its eyes still burn with fighting spirit
hud.exhaust.append.8: But a king never surrenders easily
hud.exhaust.append.9: But it will fight beside you to the end
hud.exhaust.append.10: But the moment it took the hook, it chose to stay
hud.success.nonFishCap: For {{fishName}}, you are already an emperor
hud.success.fishCap: You have become a god among {{fishName}} - in this moment, you are the fish, you are the human, you are the king.
hud.fail.bottom: Even the most mediocre {{fishName}} ({{absLevel}}) is still too hard. Upgrade your fishing rod and level, use food to boost your fishing level, and use a Trap Bobber or Cork Bobber.
